text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Japanese Derby is finally 
just around the corner.

"Around that time, a press conference was 
held for the Umamusume registered for the 
Derby."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa-wa-wa... I just peeked inside, 
and there's an insane number of 
reporters... in there...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh, my body is starting to tremble……

Still, it's probably her first press 
conference, so it's only natural she'd be 
nervous.
So, in order to ease her nerves—
choice_data_list:
When we're done, we'll go eat whatever you 
want!

When we're done, let's go eat whatever you 
want!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, did you just say 'anything' just 
now...!?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If you say 'anything'... that means 
literally anything, right?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're saying... I can order the 
Extra-Carrot-Double-Meat-Cushion-Towering-Super-Heap 
set from the Umamusume-friendly ramen 
joint near the academy...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And... does that mean we can stop by a 
family restaurant afterward and add the 
Apex Mega Max Tower Carrot Parfait on top 
of that, too!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeeep breath in............ Whew.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I'm ready. Whether it's a press 
conference or a red carpet, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you for encouraging me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The press conference... make sure you keep 
your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Special Weeeek! Please get ready!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! I'm on my way!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally time for the Japanese Derby! 
Special Week, please tell us how you're 
feeling going in!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Um...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to become Japan's number one 
Umamusume. That's why I decided to run in 
the Derby, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to get stronger, win the Derby... 
and show Mom and the others how proud I 
can make them."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, there's one more reason I want 
to win."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Another one, you say? Whatever could that 
be...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It is thanks to those precious to me that 
I am able to stand here today."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The mother who gave birth to me. The 
mother who raised me. And then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To my Trainer, who trained me so hard to 
get me this far!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to give my moms the pride of being 
the best in Japan! And I want to make 
Trainer-san a 'Derby Trainer'!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: For that reason, I will definitely win!

"...Immediately after, in the press 
conference hall wrapped in applause and 
cheers, Special Week looked straight over 
at us and flashed a wonderful smile."
